# Sulfycor

> > Sulfycor is a professional manufacturer of fire-resistant, water-resistant magnesium oxide (MgO) boards for construction applications.

Sulfycor specializes in MgO board manufacturing and provides comprehensive solutions for subfloors, wall sheathing, ceiling panels, and decorative applications. The company offers OEM/ODM services, quality assurance, and detailed installation guidance for builders and contractors.

## Key Topics

- Magnesium Oxide Board (MgO)
- Fire Resistance
- Water Resistant
- Magnesium Sulfate Board (MgSO4)
- Chloride-free
- Building Materials
- Construction Solutions
- Moisture Resistant
- Subfloor Solutions
- Wall Sheathing
- SIP Panels
- ASTM Standards
- Installation Instructions
- OEM/ODM Services
- Quality Control

## Product Solutions

- [Magnesium Oxide Board Products](https://sulfycor.com/magnesium-oxide-board-products): Main product catalog for fireproof, water-resistant MgO boards
- [MgO Board Subfloor Solutions](https://sulfycor.com/mgo-board-subfloor-solutions): MgO board subfloor solutions for durable flooring applications
- [Magnesium Oxide Sheathing Solutions](https://sulfycor.com/magnesium-oxide-sheathing-solutions): MgO board sheathing solutions for fire-resistant wall construction
- [Magnesium Wall Board Solutions](https://sulfycor.com/magnesium-wall-board-solutions): Magnesium wall board solutions for interior wall applications
- [Magnesium Oxide SIP Panels](https://sulfycor.com/magnesium-oxide-sip-panels-solutions): SIP panel solutions for energy-efficient building construction
- [Magnesium Ceiling Solutions](https://sulfycor.com/magnesium-ceiling-solutions): MgO ceiling panels for fire-resistant ceiling applications
- [MgO Decorative Wall Panels](https://sulfycor.com/mgo-decorative-wall-panels): Decorative MgO wall panels with melamine and PVC finishes
- [2mm Magnesium Wall Board For Interior Decorative Panel](https://sulfycor.com/product/2mm-magnesium-wall-board-for-interior-decorative-panel): 2mm MgO wall board product for interior decorative panels
- [Chloride-free Magnesium Sulphate Board](https://sulfycor.com/product/chloride-free-magnesium-oxide-board-mgo-board-magnesium-oxide-sulfate-board): Chloride-free MgSO4 boards for fireproof construction
